missing_data_policy.no_scene: Use fully masked fallback image. No spectral values are fabricated.
missing_data_policy.scene_but_no_valid_pixels: Satellite availability is false and spectral values remain missing.

notes: This is a 500-observation validation batch before scaling to the complete 20,000-observation satellite sample.
The same random seed as the failed V1 batch is used so the same observations are tested.
Sentinel imagery is restricted to the 14 days at or before each FIRMS event.
SCL masking removes cloud, shadow, cirrus, snow and invalid pixels.
B4/B8/B11/B12 are converted to reflectance using the 0.0001 scale.
No-scene cases use a fully masked fallback image containing the expected band names.
The fallback does not fabricate reflectance or spectral-index values.
Satellite evidence is contextual evidence, not a fire label.
